value.en: In Python, you can signal that an attribute is ***private*** (not meant to be accessed directly) by prefixing it with an underscore `_`.
value.fr: En Python, tu peux signaler qu'un attribut est ***privé*** (pas censé être accédé directement) en le préfixant avec un underscore `_`.

value.en: The `_` prefix is a ***convention*** — it tells other programmers "don't touch this directly". Python won't stop you, but you're ***not supposed to***.

value.en: A ***setter*** is a method that modifies a private attribute with ***validation*** — it checks if the new value makes sense before applying it.
